name: deed-page
title: deed.page
description: Publish files, folders, or clipboard HTML to a permanent deed.page URL, then list, update, open, and delete your sites.
author: avatar_8

commands.name: publish-file-or-folder
commands.title: Publish File or Folder
commands.subtitle: deed.page
commands.description: Publish the selected Finder item, or a file or folder you pick, to a permanent deed.page URL and copy the link.

commands.name: publish-clipboard-html
commands.title: Publish Clipboard HTML
commands.subtitle: deed.page
commands.description: Publish the HTML on your clipboard as a new deed.page site and copy the link.

commands.name: my-sites
commands.title: My Sites
commands.subtitle: deed.page
commands.description: List your deed.page sites to open, copy, update, or delete them.

preferences.name: ownerToken
preferences.title: Owner Token
preferences.description: Optional. Paste an existing deed.page owner token (deed_tok_…) to manage the sites it owns. Leave empty and your first publish creates one, stored in Raycast.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
